note: Each request lists its status; a request that has not been run has no numbers. Model, tools and renders are those of sources.json; every number below comes from that request's run directory.

text_all.what: a text request rendered on every character
text_all.request: wave with the right hand, then squat down and stand up again

video_jacks.what: a sports clip on two robots and one human character, next to the source
video_jacks.request: copy the jumping jacks the person does in the video between 10.6 s and 13.4 s

image_warrior.request: from standing, move into the pose of the person in the photo, hold it for two seconds, then return to standing

free_loop.what: free mode: a motion from a video, looped and mirrored into a longer routine
free_loop.request: Turn the jumping jacks in the video (10.6 s to 13.4 s) into a routine of about 12 seconds: loop the movement, mirror every other repeat, make the joins smooth, and show it on two robots and one human character

free_keyframe.what: free mode: text plus a pose image as a keyframe
free_keyframe.request: A person walks forward four steps and ends in the pose of the person in the photo, holding it for two seconds. Show it on three robots and both human characters

lineup_all_characters.what: the final motion of text_all on every character, one video grid
lineup_all_characters.reproduce: uv run python harness/adapters/hylo-code-agents/examples/motion_free/showcase.py run text_all && uv run python harness/adapters/hylo-code-agents/examples/motion_free/showcase.py lineup text_all
